pick.headline: Samuel Doe seizes power in Liberia; President Tolbert killed
pick.fbis: The Middle East & Africa Daily Report of April 14, 1980, listed under Liberia 'President Tolbert Overthrown by Armed Forces', then a run of coup-council items: curfew, arrest orders, a cabinet list, and a call to halt random shooting.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Middle East & Africa, Vol. V No. 073, 14 April 1980
evidence.snippet: …actions Seek Libyan Aid FAC Spokesman Says Egyptian Arms Reaching Habre Habre Sends For Reinforcements; Kamougue Suffers Losses President Oueddei Stresses Need for Neutral Force Paris Reports Resumption of Fighting AFP: Liberia Coup May Delay OAU Mediation Mission Pighting Contimes in Ndjamena 13 Apr ANNRNANNN rFWW DD ee WEST AFRICA LIBER TA President Tolbert Overthrown by Armed Forces Coup Leader Interview Imposition of Curfew Arrest Orders A…
